understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to move every selectable piece onto a goal tile marked '+'. When multiple goals existed, all of them had to be occupied simultaneously for the level to report WIN, completing the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces could be selected or moved by clicking valid grid positions, while directional moves changed the selected piece's position. Walls and obstacles blocked movement, and invalid clicks caused no movement; pieces could potentially be pushed when movement paths allowed it. Selection had to be managed carefully so pieces were placed on distinct goals rather than repeatedly moving the same piece back and forth.

understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to move every selectable piece onto a goal tile marked '+'. When multiple goals existed, all of them had to be occupied simultaneously for the level to report WIN, completing the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces could be selected or moved by clicking valid grid positions, while directional moves changed the selected piece's position. Walls and obstacles blocked movement, and invalid clicks caused no movement; pieces could potentially be pushed when movement paths allowed it. Selection had to be managed carefully so pieces were placed on distinct goals rather than repeatedly moving the same piece back and forth.
